steps.name: prefill-sha1-cache
steps.summary: run_pdf_to_drawing_workflow now bounded-memoized (LRU maxsize=32) on a cache key of sha1(pdf_bytes)+sha256 of all meta args; hits return a deepcopy so callers cannot poison the store. Completed the pre-existing test's missing _embedded_source_id helper; 4 cache tests + full suite (806) green.

steps.name: identity-header
steps.summary: X-CoilForge-Identity request header (initiator, R12c) now read via _identity_from_request (mirrors the x-coilforge-* pattern, degrades to None when absent) and threaded additively into _journal_milestone as value.request_identity — kept distinct from the event's project identity (brain_case.case_identity). Wired into all 6 journaling endpoints (ccsi-export-audit, pdf-to-direct-draft, pdf-to-drawing, checklist-fill, project-review, case-to-drawing). 2 new tests + full suite (808) green.
